kind: offline fake-provider stage profiles, no provider call
host: stanley, a 16-thread laptop with 30 GiB of RAM running other lanes' builds and tests
database: DBpedia 2022.12.01, 1.01 billion quads, 32 GB on disk

settings.pageCache: warm, the runs follow one another with the database already read by earlier runs

definitions.localMs: elapsedMs minus modelMs, summed over the initial ask and the answered ask
definitions.firstClarifyMs: elapsedMs of an initial ask that ended in a clarification
definitions.paired: median over questions of the candidate's value minus the base's, for questions present in both runs

retainedReplay.note: the 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25 paid binaries replayed in per-process mode on 2026-11-13 under other load
